Hi Ben,

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up and sorry for the friction. Quick plan: 

- I can trigger a single automatic reattempt through our Stripe billing flow and also generate a secure card-update link if you prefer to add a new card.
- We will hold off on service interruption while we resolve this.
- I’ll loop in our billing ops for the dispute evidence if Stripe shows an active chargeback (can you forward the dispute ID if you have it?).

For VAT: can you confirm the BrightRetail VAT ID and the country for tax reporting? I’ll attach a reconciliation CSV and the VAT line item on the invoice for your accounting team.

Proposed next steps:
1) You reply with preference: retry card vs. new card link.
2) If retry, I’ll schedule a reattempt for 06/12 08:00 PT and confirm the outcome.
3) If chargeback, we’ll prepare evidence (usage logs, invoice, signed contract). Rafael from Ops will submit to Stripe.

Attaching: reconciliation_202605.csv (contains invoice line breakdown).

—Ben

Monica, flag if we need legal or CSM involvement. Laura, I may need approval for a one-time invoice hold / no-interruption escalation.

- Invoice (BR-7892_INV_20260531.pdf).
- Reconciliation of tokens/usage for May (reconciliation_202605.csv).
- Any email authorization or POs.

I will plan to attempt a single retry on 06/12 08:00 PT unless BrightRetail opts to update card. Rafael, please upload evidence to Stripe and ping chargebacks@stripe.com with the dispute id.

Elena / team,

Quick update and confirmation of actions taken: 

1) BrightRetail updated the card on file on 06/12 per your note — thanks. We scheduled a single automatic reattempt on 06/13 and it succeeded; amount settled.
2) Because Stripe had an open dispute (DP_01F3) we proactively submitted an evidence packet on 06/13 containing: signed SOW, invoice BR-7892_INV_20260531.pdf, reconciliation_202605.csv, and usage logs. Evidence filename: evidence_chargeback_1.jpg (snapshot of contract acceptance).
3) I asked Stripe to withdraw the dispute; they acknowledged receipt and set a 7-14 day review window. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/BR-7892.

VAT: we added a VAT line in the invoice breakdown and confirmed BrightRetail's VAT ID (BE0123456789) — full VAT detail is in the attached reconciliation CSV. If your accounting team needs a VAT-only invoice, we can reissue.

Attachments included: BR-7892_INV_20260531.pdf, reconciliation_202605.csv, evidence_chargeback_1.jpg

If anything else is needed for your procurement team (PO references, remittance instructions), let me know. Laura/Monica — please confirm we can clear the invoice hold and mark the account as good for renewal outreach next month. Rafael — please follow up with Stripe until dispute status is closed.

Thanks for the quick coordination,
—Ben
